scope: Published numbers for the SWaT/MSL/SMAP/PSM/SMD family, transcribed from the PDFs stored under papers/literature/mtsad_pdfs (local only). Every value carries the object it was read from.
extraction_method: pdftotext -layout on the local PDF, table text transcribed verbatim; no value is carried over from memory.
protocol_caveat: The papers do not share one protocol. Anomaly Transformer and DCdetector report point-adjusted F1 with per-paper preprocessing; TranAD reports F1 with its own threshold rule and does not evaluate PSM. Column-wise equality across papers is therefore not evidence of like-for-like evaluation.
metric_family_caveat: This file holds the point-adjusted family only. Reported numbers that belong to the affiliation family (CATCH's Table 2) are kept separately in mtsad_reported_affiliation.json, because the two families differ by up to 0.53 in precision on the same series and mixing them would be a category error.

sources.reported_protocol: point-adjusted F1 with the authors' own preprocessing; the paper does not state the threshold rule in the table caption
point-adjusted F1 as re-produced by the DCdetector authors
sources.note: The same method (Anomaly Transformer) is reported as SMD 92.33 by its authors and 90.33 here, which quantifies how much the reported rank depends on the re-run harness.
